verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਪੀਰਾਂ ਪੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhee gaakhaRee peeraa(n) peer guraa(n) gur jaanai|

en.bdb: Discipleship of the Guru is a difficult task; any pir or Guru of the Gurus knows it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲੈ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur dhaa upadhes lai veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: Accepting the teachings of the true Guru and going beyond the wordly illusions He identifies that Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਬਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: muradhaa hoi mureedh so gur sikh jai samai babaanai|

en.bdb: Only that Sikh of the Guru absorbs his self into Baba (Nanak) who has become dead to his carnal desires.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਤੀਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee(n) pai paakhaak hoi tis paakhaak paak pateeaanai|

en.bdb: Fall­ing at the Guru's feet he becomes the dust of his feet; people consider such dust of the feet of a humble Sikh as sacred.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਛਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th aga(n)m hai mar mar jeevai jai pachhaanai|

en.bdb: Unapproachable is the way of gurmukhs; while being dead they remain alive (i.e. they make only their desires dead), and ultimately they identify the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar keeRee bhira(n)gee vaa(n)g vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Inspired by the teach­ings of the Guru and adopting the conduct of bhritigi insect (which trans­forms small ant into bhringt), he (the disciple) attains the grandeur and great­ness of the Guru.
Who, in fact, can describe this ineffable story?
